title: Just Respect the Semantics: Image-Token Compression via Pre-LLM Semantic Variable-Resolution Tokenization and In-LLM Relevance Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.18690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image-token compression must reduce computation without hurting the semantics. We introduce Varest, guided by semantic fungibility: tokens within a coherent semantic region can be summarized coarsely, while object boundaries and literal text require finer distinctions. Object and text localizers guide variable-resolution merging, preserving spatial coverage and finer detail at boundaries and text. Learned [REL] registers then prune visual tokens after early decoder processing. Training across budgets enables one checkpoint per backbone. Across three backbones and 13 benchmarks, Varest outperforms 15 baselines in mean performance retention at every evaluated budget, retaining 86.10-92.33% of full-token performance with only 5.56% of the original layer-averaged image-token count.

translated_title: 尊重语义即可：通过LLM前语义可变分辨率分词与LLM内相关性剪枝实现图像token压缩
translated_abstract: 图像token压缩必须在不损害语义的前提下减少计算量。我们提出Varest，其核心指导原则是语义可替代性：连贯语义区域内的token可以被粗略概括，而物体边界和文字内容则需要更精细的区分。物体和文本定位器引导可变分辨率合并，在边界和文字处保留空间覆盖范围和更精细的细节。学习到的[REL]寄存器随后在解码器早期处理之后对视觉token进行剪枝。跨预算的训练方式使得每个骨干网络只需一个检查点。在三个骨干网络和13个基准测试上，Varest在每个评估预算下的平均性能保持率均优于15个基线方法，仅使用原始层平均图像token数量的5.56%即可保留全token性能的86.10%至92.33%。
tldr: Varest通过语义引导的可变分辨率token化与相关性token剪枝，仅用5.56%的图像token即可保留86%-92%的全token性能，实现高效且语义无损的图像token压缩。
en_tdlr: Varest achieves efficient image-token compression through semantic-guided variable-resolution tokenization and learned relevance pruning, retaining 86-92% of full-token performance with only 5.56% of the image tokens.
